notes.title: Update 04/01/23
notes.notes:
[b]Now English localization is polished again![/b]
To make the game compatible for more players, we implemented [b]graphic quality setting[/b]:
 - Press [b]ctrl + X + 1/2/3[/b] in game to switch to Low / High / Ultra quaility (Ultra is default)
 - You can also enter the following launch options in the "Properties" menu of the Steam library page of this game: -screen-quality Low / High / Ultra
